about: Another application activated while a window's popup is open (the audit in docs/react-native-android-adaptation.mdx, "Popups following their window"): on a Mac a menu or a transient popover closes when its application stops being the active one (Command-Tab). EditingProbe is the scenario's application (Allo) and PopupWindowProbe (sample/PopupWindowProbe.tsx) a second application beside it (`companion`), in the session's shell. A press on the companion's Actions opens its menu; the shell's Super+Tab closes the menu as the switcher opens (the compositor dismisses the grab before telling the shell: no key reaches either application), and its release activates Allo: the companion's window hears it lost the keyboard and React nothing, and its page counts the menu closed once. The same with its popover, once a first press on the inactive companion has only activated it (a Mac's first click, docs/adr/0016-windows.mdx, decision 9) and a second has opened it. Each step checks the compositor's focus, what each client was delivered, exactly what each React tree heard and each popup's lifecycle.
